findings.message: INI directive 'register_globals' is deprecated since PHP 5.3 and removed since PHP 5.4 (ini_get()/ini_set() of a directive that no longer exists returns false without an error, and this directive was already gone before PHP 8.3, so the upgrade changes nothing)
